product_one_liner.value: Disprz is an AI-powered learning and skilling platform combining learning management, personalized learning experiences, and AI content authoring to help enterprises develop workforce capabilities.
product_one_liner.notes: The homepage describes an enterprise learning and skilling platform combining LMS, LXP, and AI content authoring to build workforce capability. Source: https://disprz.ai/

pricing_page.notes: A public Disprz plans and pricing page exists; public numerical prices are not required by the question. Source: https://disprz.ai/pricing

named_customers.notes: named_customers: The homepage explicitly names Amazon and Axis Bank among companies that trust Disprz to power workforce capability, establishing customer relationships rather than investor or partner status. Source: https://disprz.ai/ | named_customers.0: Amazon is explicitly named as a company trusting Disprz for workforce capability. Source: https://disprz.ai/ | named_customers.1: Axis Bank is explicitly named as a company trusting Disprz for workforce capability. Source: https://disprz.ai/

employee_band.notes: The company LinkedIn profile reports the requested 201–500 employee band. This is a self-reported range rather than an exact audited headcount. Source: https://linkedin.com/company/13366982

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The company lists its North America HQ in West Orange, and the LinkedIn company profile also identifies West Orange, New Jersey, as headquarters. The regional designation on the company page creates some ambiguity about global HQ status. Sources: https://disprz.ai/company/about-us and https://linkedin.com/company/13366982 | hq_country: The company lists its North America HQ in West Orange, New Jersey, USA, and its LinkedIn profile identifies West Orange as headquarters. The regional HQ label creates some ambiguity about its global headquarters designation. Sources: https://disprz.ai/company/about-us and https://linkedin.com/company/13366982

founded_year.notes: The company-issued funding announcement explicitly states that Disprz was established in 2015. Source: https://www.prnewswire.com/apac/news-releases/disprz-ignites-the-future-of-workplace-learning-and-skills-with-us30m-series-c-funding-301894503.html

eng_blog.notes: The readable blog index contains L&D guidance, learning-industry marketing, and product/customer content; it did not establish two engineer-authored posts explaining how Disprz is built. Technical-sounding learning or integration guides do not meet that criterion. Source: https://disprz.ai/blog

public_docs.notes: The public knowledge base lists numerous product-help articles covering user administration, and a substantive external API guide documents authentication and API usage. This exceeds a lone FAQ or empty portal. Sources: https://resource.disprz.com/kbtest/user-administration and https://disprz.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/PS/pages/2760245302/Disprz+External+API+guide

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The official careers site has a live AI Content Operations Intern posting with an application action. Its title contains AI and its responsibilities involve GenAI content operations, satisfying the question's title-based rule, although it is not an ML engineering or research position. Older AI Engineer listings were closed and were not used as evidence of an opening. Source: https://disprz.keka.com/careers/jobdetails/140799

model_provider.notes: Microsoft's Disprz customer story explicitly says Disprz uses Azure OpenAI to drive personalization. This establishes product use, unlike the separate reference to OpenAI Assistants for internal productivity. Source: https://www.microsoft.com/en-in/aifirstmovers/disprz

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: Disprz's trust page claims ISO 27001:2022 certification, SOC 2 Type II attestation, and GDPR compliance. GDPR is included as a publicly claimed compliance framework under the requested categories, not as an independently issued certification. Source: https://compliance.disprz.ai/ | compliance_certs.0: The trust page explicitly claims SOC 2 Type II attestation. Source: https://compliance.disprz.ai/ | compliance_certs.1: The trust page explicitly claims ISO 27001:2022 certification. Source: https://compliance.disprz.ai/ | compliance_certs.2: The trust page explicitly claims compliance with GDPR, one of the requested frameworks. Source: https://compliance.disprz.ai/

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: Both the company funding announcement and the latest-round database description identify the round as Series C. Latest-round status relies partly on a secondary source. Sources: https://www.prnewswire.com/apac/news-releases/disprz-ignites-the-future-of-workplace-learning-and-skills-with-us30m-series-c-funding-301894503.html and https://www.thecompanycheck.com/company/b/disprz/01gasqtv7pilzz9c4 | funding_date: The latest-round profile gives August 2023, consistent with the company announcement dated August 7, 2023; the month is normalized to 2023-08. Sources: https://www.thecompanycheck.com/company/b/disprz/01gasqtv7pilzz9c4 and https://www.prnewswire.com/apac/news-releases/disprz-ignites-the-future-of-workplace-learning-and-skills-with-us30m-series-c-funding-301894503.html | funding_amount_usd: The company announcement states a US$30 million Series C round, and the company database profile identifies that August 2023 round as the most recent funding activity. raised_18mo.notes: The most recent documented funding round is August 2023, corroborated by the dated company announcement. That predates the 18-month window beginning in May 2025. Latest-round status relies partly on the company database profile. Sources: https://www.thecompanycheck.com/company/b/disprz/01gasqtv7pilzz9c4 and https://www.prnewswire.com/apac/news-releases/disprz-ignites-the-future-of-workplace-learning-and-skills-with-us30m-series-c-funding-301894503.html

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The current official careers board lists AD–Presales, AI Content Operations Intern, Senior Security Manager, and AD–Sales, but no SDR, BDR, sales/business development representative, or account executive title. Director-level sales and presales titles do not meet the specified rule; an older Account Executive listing was closed. Source: https://disprz.keka.com/careers

launched_6mo.notes: A September 28, 2026 announcement states that Disprz unveiled Autonomous Enablement OS, a new AI-native system for end-to-end enablement and employee coaching. This is a major product launch within the six-month window. Source: https://www.ptinews.com/press-release/disprz-crosses-130-crore-arr-and-launches-autonomous-enablement-os-pioneering-a-new-category-beyond-traditional-l-d/4107975

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Unknown. The leadership page lists 18 people but provides no joining dates, so it does not establish whether a qualifying executive joined or left within the window. The dated Sabari Viswanathan CTO-in-residence announcement is from July 12, 2022, not the requested period. No qualifying recent transition was verified. Sources reviewed: https://disprz.ai/company/about-us and https://www.financialexpress.com/jobs-career/education-disprz-ropes-in-sabari-viswanathan-as-cto-in-residence-2591669/
